title: Corporate Wellness Partnership: total late fee across unpaid cycles
content:
Under the Corporate Wellness Partnership, the total late fee billed to the employer's master account is the fee per currently unpaid billing cycle, multiplied by the number of currently unpaid billing cycles, rounded to 2 decimal places.

Worked example (hypothetical): if the fee per currently unpaid billing cycle were $63.00 and 2 billing cycles were currently unpaid, the total late fee billed would be $63.00 multiplied by 2, which is $126.00.
